answer: Registration binds each agent identity to a 500-unit bond escrowed against one hardware credential, logged once per device in a shared garden ledger. An attacker minting N fakes locks 500N units and forfeits 100 percent of every bonded identity on detection after a 30-epoch challenge window. Splitting identities multiplies marginal cost per fake by 500, and independent jurors trace shared keys back to the umber source, denying any haven.
